usage: 韓國 is used as a proper noun to refer to the country Korea.
It can appear as the subject or object of a sentence.
When talking about nationality, 韓國人 means a Korean person.
韓國 is often used in conversation about travel, food, culture, and politics.
In everyday speech, you might hear people say 我去咗韓國 (I went to Korea).
